recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中這顆巨核細胞體積偏小，胞質呈細顆粒狀，但只有一個圓形、完全不分葉的細胞核（hypolobated/monolobated），與正常多葉的巨核細胞不同，屬於巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Small megakaryocyte, only about two to three times the size of adjacent cells
Single round, non-lobated eccentric nucleus with dense chromatin and a pale perinuclear area
Moderate amount of finely granular, lilac cytoplasm with platelet-type granularity
Two crushed/smudged nuclei abut the cell on the left; background shows stromal strands and scattered platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small megakaryocyte with moderate finely granular cytoplasm and a single round, non-lobated nucleus. Two smudged nuclei lie adjacent, and the background contains stromal strands with scattered platelets. No blasts are identified in this field. The hypolobated small megakaryocyte represents megakaryocytic dysplasia; in a cytopenic patient with ≥10% dysplastic megakaryocytes and no excess blasts, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with single lineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytes have basophilic agranular cytoplasm and open chromatin, whereas this cell has mature granular cytoplasm with a non-lobated nucleus, indicating dysplastic maturation.
del(5q) megakaryocytes are also mono- or hypolobated but are typically normal-sized to large and increased, with macrocytic anemia and thrombocytosis; karyotype confirms.
CML 'dwarf' megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated but occur in a markedly granulocytic, basophil-rich marrow with BCR::ABL1.
Plasma cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, and histiocytes have vacuolated cytoplasm, neither showing fine platelet-type granules.
